description: Request that a human visits a location in a given time window and reports conditions such as noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile signal and cleanliness, with evidence. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 69 per report in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

aspects.description: What to check, e.g. noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile_signal, cleanliness, light, parking, atmosphere/vibe.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

context.description: Optional: purpose, e.g. flat for a family with a baby.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

name: request_condition_report
title: Request an on-site condition report
